popupExpandToggleTip: Grow inner scrollable panels and iframes to their full content instead of capturing them as seen. Cross-site frames ask for an extra permission once.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and synced to your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission granted — frames from other sites are expanded too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, cross-site frames are captured as seen. Panels and same-site iframes always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Scans the text a page exposes for emails, phone numbers, credit-card numbers, SSNs and API keys, and paints a solid block over what it matches in the saved image. It cannot read text drawn as pixels — a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. Detection runs on your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. Full-page (document-scroll) captures; the block is permanent, so review the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF plays everywhere. WebM is smaller & smoother (recorded live in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages needs one-time permission the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: Permission to open those pages was declined.
